I wrote the profile settings form to `./solution.tsx`. I couldn't run it, so it's untested. I did check that `--space-24` and `--text` exist in the Orrery token CSS.

- **Display name:** a text field with the hint "Shown to your crew."
- **Time zone:** a select with UTC, Berlin and Tokyo, and the placeholder "Choose a time zone".
- **Email switch:** a switch labelled "Email me about new orbits".
- **Save button:** a primary "Save profile" button that submits the form. After saving, "Profile saved." appears next to it as status text. It clears when any field changes.

The page uses the kit components (`Field`, `Input`, `Select`, `Switch`, `Button`) and only brand variables for spacing and colour. It should follow whichever of the three brands is active.
